battle.name: 豬灣事件
battle.brief: 豬灣事件是1961年4月美國中央情報局支持流亡古巴武裝「旅團2506」在古巴豬灣登陸，並與古巴革命軍交戰的武裝衝突。行動結合空中突襲與岸灘進攻，因游擊隊後續火力及登陸支援中斷而失敗；戰場所用地面武器包括蘇制別丹步槍（Berdan rifle）。

kit.name: 別丹步槍
kit.history: 別丹步槍是蘇聯陸軍早期採用的栓動式制式步槍，主要配發給步兵分隊，作為營連層級地面作戰中的直線射擊武器。

countries: 豬灣事件發生於1961年4月16日至19日，地點在古巴南部希龍角一帶；英語所稱 Bay of Pigs 源自英國海圖上的 Bahía de Cochinos，實際主要登陸灘則是 Playa Girón 與 Playa Larga。直接交戰的一方是古巴革命軍，另一方是由古巴流亡軍人組成、受美國中央情報局訓練與支援的第二五〇六旅。美國沒有以公開部隊參戰，卻提供策劃、武器、運輸、航空作戰與情報支援。瓜地馬拉提供主要訓練場和集結地，尼加拉瓜則被利用作空運、加油及轉場節點。蘇聯沒有派兵參戰，但一艘載有 IL-28 航空器與軍用貨物的蘇聯商船在行動前被美方飛機擊沉，成為後續危機的一部分。
countriesEn: The Pig's Bay operation took place from 16 to 19 April 1961 around Cape Girón in southern Cuba. The English name Bay of Pigs came from the British chart designation Bahía de Cochinos, while the principal landing beaches were actually Playa Girón and Playa Larga. The direct belligerents were the Cuban Revolutionary Army and Brigade 2506, a force of Cuban military exiles trained and supported by the United States Central Intelligence Agency. No openly identified American troops took part, although the United States supplied planning, weapons, transportation, air operations, and intelligence. Guatemala provided the main training and assembly area, while Nicaragua served as a staging, refueling, and transfer point for air operations. The Soviet Union sent no troops into the battle, but a Soviet freighter carrying IL-28 aircraft and military cargo was sunk by an American aircraft before the invasion, becoming part of the later crisis.
people: 美方最高決策者是總統德懷特·艾森豪，他批准中央情報局的秘密方案；約翰·F·肯尼迪於1961年就任後接手此案，雖對公開介入深感棘手，仍在戰況惡化時同意有限的後續空襲。中央情報局局長艾倫·杜勒斯與副局長理查德·比塞爾負責整體監督，前者維持白宮、國務院與策劃單位之間的高層運作，後者直接推動第二五〇六旅的訓練、運輸及作戰配合。曼紐爾·阿爾蒂梅是流亡旅的公開指揮者，阿爾韋托·巴約參與原始方案與訓練，何塞·阿爾弗雷多·聖羅曼上校任作戰參謀長並實際掌握灘頭。古巴方面，菲德爾·卡斯特羅親自決定反擊方向，豪爾赫·施瓦茨上校率第二方面軍投入戰鬥，洪伯托·索里負責作戰協調；卡斯特羅、施瓦茨與索里在四月十七日抵達前線後，迅速把原本分散的部隊組成反擊。
peopleEn: The senior American decision-maker was President Dwight Eisenhower, who approved the Central Intelligence Agency's covert plan. John F. Kennedy inherited the operation when he took office in 1961; although he was acutely concerned about the consequences of overt involvement, he permitted limited additional air support as the situation deteriorated. CIA Director Allen Dulles and Deputy Director for Plans Richard Bissell supervised the undertaking. Dulles managed relations among the White House, the State Department, and the planners, while Bissell directly coordinated the training, movement, and operational support of Brigade 2506. Manuel Artime was the exile brigade's public commander, Alberto Bayo helped formulate the original plan and training program, and Colonel José Alfredo San Román served as chief of staff and exercised practical command of the beachhead. On the Cuban side, Fidel Castro personally directed the counterattack, Colonel Jorge Schwartz committed the Second Front to the battle, and Humberto Sorí handled operational coordination. After Castro, Schwartz, and Sorí reached the front on 17 April, they rapidly combined previously dispersed Cuban units into a counteroffensive.
kits: 第二五〇六旅的突擊人員主要使用 M1 加蘭德步槍、M1 卡賓槍，另有 Browning M1919 輕機槍與 M2 重機槍；步槍彈藥以 7.62×51 毫米規格為主，機槍則配相應的 7.62 毫米或 12.7 毫米彈藥。支援火力包括 M3 60 公厘迫擊砲、81 公厘迫擊砲，以及 M2A1 105 公厘野戰榴彈砲。車輛以 GMC CCKW 二點五噸卡車為主，搭配 LCVP 登陸艇與大型兩棲平底駁船，另有野戰無線電、醫療器材及數日份糧食、燃料和彈藥。空軍方面，中央情報局航空隊以 B-26 Marauder 轟炸機為主力，使用 T-6 Texan 執行武裝偵察與近距支援，部分 B-25 Mitchell 也參與較後期的空襲；B-26 攜帶百磅炸彈及火箭彈。古巴軍可用 MiG-15bis 戰鬥機、Yak-18 飛機、ZiS-3 76.2 公厘野戰砲、45 公厘反戰車砲與蘇聯制式迫擊砲。上述型號在1961年以前均已列裝。
kitsEn: Brigade 2506's assault personnel were primarily armed with M1 Garand rifles and M1 carbines, supported by Browning M1919 light machine guns and M2 heavy machine guns. Most rifle ammunition was 7.62×51 mm, with matching 7.62 mm or 12.7 mm ammunition for the machine guns. Support weapons included M3 60 mm mortars, 81 mm mortars, and M2A1 105 mm field howitzers. GMC CCKW 2.5-ton trucks formed the core of its vehicle fleet, while LCVP landing craft and large amphibious flat-bottom barges moved troops and supplies. The force also carried field radios, medical equipment, and several days of rations, fuel, and ammunition. On the American air side, the CIA air arm relied chiefly on B-26 Marauder bombers, used T-6 Texan aircraft for armed reconnaissance and close support, and employed some B-25 Mitchell bombers in later strikes. The B-26s carried hundred-pound bombs and rockets. Cuban forces could field MiG-15bis fighters, Yak-18 aircraft, ZiS-3 76.2 mm field guns, 45 mm anti-tank guns, and Soviet-pattern mortars. Every type named here had entered service before 1961.
tactics: 作戰前，CIA 先在加勒比海擊沉載有 IL-28 航空器與軍用貨物的蘇聯商船 Markov，迫使古巴加強南部地區戒備。4月15日，B-26 與 T-6 對聖安東尼奧、聖胡利安等機場及通信節點實施襲擊，並透過假消息表示主攻方向可能是聖安東尼奧，使古巴指揮部把部分預備隊留在哈瓦那西側。4月16日晚，突擊旅由接應船換乘登陸艇；部分 LCVP 接近灘岸時擱在珊瑚淺灘，人員必須涉水至腰際或更深處卸下裝備。首批卡車、砲位、物資和傷員集中在狹窄通道，灘頭很快出現堵塞。天亮後，旅在 Playa Larga 與 Playa Girón 兩端建立灘頭，105 公厘砲及迫擊砲被移往內陸，卻未迅速占領可供轟炸機使用的機場。古巴方面的反擊在4月17日午前形成，卡斯特羅到達後把部隊集中於公路與林緣，步兵由西側及北側向灘頭壓迫；古巴戰鬥機與高射砲則迫使 B-26 冒低空風險，短暫壓制灘頭火力。4月18日，古巴軍在炮火掩護下連續攻擊中央與北段陣地，破壞交通、削弱通訊並迫使火炮後撤，突擊旅被壓向 Playa Larga 與薩帕塔沼澤邊緣，聖羅曼也在戰鬥中陣亡。4月19日，中央情報局雖進行最後空襲，古巴軍仍從公路及沼澤兩側推進，切斷數個營彼此；失去縱深、彈藥和有效空援後，殘餘指揮部在下午下令停火投降，整場地面戰從登陸到崩解不足七十二小時。
tacticsEn: Before the invasion, CIA aircraft sank the Soviet freighter Markov in the Caribbean while it was carrying IL-28 aircraft and military cargo, forcing Cuba to strengthen its southern defenses. On 15 April, B-26 and T-6 aircraft attacked airfields and communications sites around San Antonio, San Julián, and other locations, while false reports suggested that the main attack would come at San Antonio. That deception induced the Cuban command to retain part of its reserve on the Havana side. On the night of 16 April, the invasion force transferred from the waiting transports into landing craft. Some LCVPs struck the coral shallows close to shore, so men had to wade through water at or above waist depth while unloading. Early trucks, gun positions, supplies, and casualties congested the narrow access routes and quickly obstructed the beach. After daylight, the brigade established positions at Playa Larga and Playa Girón. Its 105 mm guns and mortars were moved inland, but it did not promptly seize an airfield usable by the bombers. Cuban counterattacks took shape before noon on 17 April. Castro arrived and concentrated troops along the roads and wooded approaches, pressing the beachhead from the west and north. Cuban fighters and antiaircraft guns forced the B-26s to operate at low altitude while briefly suppressing the beachhead fires. On 18 April, artillery-supported Cuban attacks struck the center and northern positions, damaged communications and routes, and forced the guns backward. The invasion force was compressed toward Playa Larga and the edge of the Ciénaga de Zapata marshes, where San Román was killed in combat. On 19 April, the CIA mounted one final air strike, but Cuban troops continued advancing along the roads and through the swamp approaches, separating several battalions. With its depth, ammunition, and effective air support gone, the surviving command ordered a cease-fire and surrender that afternoon. The entire ground operation, from landing to collapse, lasted less than seventy-two hours.
data: 第二五〇六旅約有一千四百至一千五百人，編制包含六個步兵營，以及炮兵、通信、工兵、醫療和後勤分隊。徵募與初步訓練自1960年11月開始，1961年第一季度在瓜地馬拉完成密集演練，人員還以夜間飛行與傘降方式熟悉古巴海岸。船隊在四月上旬離開瓜地馬拉，沿海路避開古巴巡邏艇，4月15日在古巴南部外海會合，16日把人員和物資轉裝至登陸艇，17日凌晨約兩時開始登陸；至19日下午投降，歷時約六十餘小時。糧食按數日作戰配置，額外砲彈、迫擊砲彈、燃料、卡車與救護用品雖隨船抵達，卻因灘灘阻塞而未能迅速送入縱深。接應船隊始終停在外海，既無法迅速補給，也不能在古巴軍占領灘頭後安全送員；突擊旅未能奪取前線機場，因而從未建立可持續的空中補給走廊。
dataEn: Brigade 2506 numbered approximately 1,400 to 1,500 men and was organized into six infantry battalions together with artillery, communications, engineers, medical, and logistics detachments. Recruitment and preliminary training began in November 1960, and intensive exercises were completed in Guatemala during the first quarter of 1961. Personnel also flew by night and descended by parachute to familiarize themselves with the Cuban coast. The ship movement left Guatemala in early April, proceeded along a coastal route that avoided Cuban patrol craft, and rendezvoused off southern Cuba on 15 April. On 16 April, troops and supplies were transferred into landing craft, and the operation began around 0200 on 17 April. The surrender came in the afternoon of 19 April, after roughly sixty hours of fighting. Rations were calculated for several days of operations. Additional mortar and artillery ammunition, fuel, trucks, and medical supplies arrived with the convoy but could not be moved rapidly into the depth of the beachhead because the unloading area was congested. The transport fleet remained offshore, unable either to deliver resupply quickly or to land personnel safely after Cuban troops occupied the beach. Because the brigade never seized an airfield in the forward area, it never established a sustainable air-supply corridor.
cause: 豬灣行動源於古巴革命後美國的政策判斷。1959年古巴局勢推翻巴蒂斯塔政府後，美資經營的糖廠、銀行與煉油設施被收歸國有，古巴又擴大與蘇聯的經濟及安全聯繫，美國於1961年1月中斷外交關係。CIA評估認為古巴革命軍仍帶有推翻舊軍時的派系裂痕，若由流亡軍人突然登陸，古巴指揮官可能不敢持續抵抗，因此規劃以第二五〇六旅奪取機場、擴大灘頭，並迅速向哈瓦那方向推進。艾森豪與CIA都重視可推卸的公開痕跡，流亡軍人前線使美方能把行動描述為古巴人的內部行動。計畫本身高度依賴制空優勢、灘頭迅速卸載及古巴軍士氣不穩三項假設，卻低估了卡斯特羅對軍隊的整編能力、中央情報局對實際兵力與命令系統的掌握，以及古巴快速修通道路、調動後方部隊的能力。Markov 商船事件和古巴反情報工作的發現，又使美方在情報尚未完全澄清時加快既定日程。
causeEn: The Pig's Bay operation grew out of American assessments of Cuba after the 1959 revolution. Following the overthrow of the Batista government, Cuba nationalized American-owned sugar mills, banks, and oil refineries while deepening its economic and security ties with the Soviet Union, and the United States broke diplomatic relations in January 1961. CIA planners judged that the Cuban Revolutionary Army still contained factional divisions dating from the overthrow of the old army. They expected an abrupt landing by exiles to cause some Cuban commanders to hesitate, and therefore designed Brigade 2506 to seize airfields, expand its beachhead, and drive toward Havana. Eisenhower and the CIA also valued a façade of deniability; the exile front allowed the American side to portray the operation as a Cuban-directed affair. The plan depended on air superiority, rapid unloading, and weak Cuban resolve, yet it underestimated Castro's ability to unify the army, the CIA's knowledge of actual troop strengths and command arrangements, and the Cubans' capacity to repair roads and move reserves. The Markov incident and Cuban counter-intelligence discoveries then encouraged the American planners to accelerate an already fixed timetable before their intelligence questions had been fully resolved.
impact: 古巴在戰場上的勝利立刻改變了事件的性質：它不只是一次流亡突擊失敗，而是證明卡斯特羅能以軍隊、指揮與後勤體系擊敗由美國情報機構策劃的攻勢。卡斯特羅因此獲得新的軍事與政治威望，古巴政權進一步公開朝社會主義方向鞏固，蘇聯也隨後增加軍事裝備、顧問與經濟援助。美國則在聯合國安理會與美洲國家組織面臨嚴重外交處境；肯尼迪政府先否認美國直接參戰，之後不得不承認中央情報局策劃並支援行動。美國輿論迫使白宮終止這套登陸組織，但也留下兩個制度教訓：秘密代理作戰不能取代明確的戰略目標，而沒有奪取機場、空中補給與灘頭縱深，再精銳的突擊旅也難以持續。豬灣事件加深美古互信破裂，成為後續古巴導彈危機前美方處理古巴問題時更加戒慎的背景之一。
impactEn: The Cuban battlefield victory immediately changed the character of the affair. It was not merely the failure of an exile raid; it demonstrated that Castro could defeat an offensive planned and supported by the United States intelligence service through a combination of command, military organization, and logistics. Castro consequently gained additional military and political authority, the Cuban government consolidated its openly socialist direction, and the Soviet Union subsequently increased its provision of military equipment, advisers, and economic assistance. The United States faced a severe diplomatic situation at the United Nations Security Council and the Organization of American States. The Kennedy administration initially denied direct American participation before acknowledging that the CIA had planned and supported the operation. American political pressure forced the White House to terminate the invasion organization, but two institutional lessons remained: covert proxy warfare could not replace a clear strategic objective, and an assault force without captured airfields, air resupply, and depth in its beachhead could not remain effective. The Pig's Bay affair deepened the breakdown of mutual confidence between Washington and Havana and became one of the background conditions that made the later Cuban missile crisis even more dangerous.
result: 4月19日下午，古巴軍占據灘頭公路並切斷各營聯繫後，第二五〇六旅指揮部停止抵抗，要求殘餘部隊放下武器。可確認的結果是突擊旅作為有組織的戰鬥單位當日瓦解，逾千名武裝人員被俘，另有相當數量陣亡、受傷、失散或由海上逃離；由於各方的名冊、陣亡認定與逃亡統計不一致，較可靠的做法是保留這些區間，而不宣稱單一精確傷亡數字。古巴軍亦有數百人以上的傷亡，並繳獲大量槍砲、迫擊砲、無線電與卡車。聖羅曼與索里在作戰中陣亡，阿爾蒂梅則逃出並返回美國；CIA的B-26與T-6也因防空火力、高射砲和戰機攔截受到損失。美方沒有派第二批部隊登陸，沒有奪得機場，也沒有開通補給空廊，故無法扭轉灘頭崩潰。古巴保有全部灘區與制空、制海優勢，實際控制了戰役。
resultEn: After Cuban troops occupied the beachhead road and cut the battalions apart on the afternoon of 19 April, the command of Brigade 2506 stopped resistance and ordered the surviving troops to lay down their arms. The certain result was that the exile brigade ceased to exist as an organized fighting force that day. More than a thousand armed personnel were captured, while a substantial number were killed, wounded, missing, or escaped by sea. Because the rosters, definitions of combat deaths, and escape records differ among sources, these broad categories are more reliable than any single exact casualty figure. Cuban forces also sustained several hundred or more casualties and recovered large quantities of rifles, machine guns, mortars, radios, and trucks. San Román and Sorí were killed in the fighting, while Artime escaped and returned to the United States. CIA B-26 and T-6 aircraft also suffered losses to antiaircraft fire and fighter interception. The United States sent no second landing wave, captured no airfield, and opened no resupply corridor, so nothing could reverse the collapse on the beach. Cuba retained the entire beach area and its air and maritime advantage and therefore controlled the outcome of the battle.
